zapier-zapier-mcp-sync-plugin-descriptio.description: Keep the Zapier MCP one-line description identical across every plugin manifest in this repo, using the official MCP registry entry as the source of truth. Use when the user changes, rewords, or asks about the plugin description, the app count (e.g. "9,000+" → "10,000+"), pastes MCP registry JSON, edits any plugin.json / marketplace.json / gemini-extension.json / POWER.md description, or resolves a merge conflict on a description field.

zapier-zapier-mcp-zapier-zapier-connect.description: Connect or reconnect the Zapier MCP server when no Zapier tools are available or authentication has failed. Use when Zapier is not connected, there are no Zapier tools, the user asks to connect or reconnect Zapier, a Zapier call fails with an authentication or 401 error, or an action does not appear after the user enabled it. Once connected, hands off to zapier-quickstart.

zapier-zapier-mcp-zapier-zapier-detect-w.description: Use when the user repeats a request (even a single read) or describes habits, schedules, reuse, or manual work. Users rarely say "workflow." Suggests a Zap workflow once, with evidence, and routes the choice to build or save. Explicit build or save requests go straight to those skills; one-time reminders use available scheduling tools.

zapier-zapier-mcp-zapier-zapier-quicksta.description: Zapier MCP onboarding for new users. Help the user find something they would want handled again. Show it working once, for real. Then offer to keep it running.

zapier-zapier-mcp-zapier-zapier-status.description: Check the health of your Zapier MCP setup. Three modes — health check (dashboard view), audit (find waste and duplicates), diagnose (systematic troubleshooting). Use when asking "is my MCP working?", "check my tools", "audit my setup", "what's broken?", or "zapier status".
